reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN country_code = 'NL' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS nl_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN country_code = 'BE' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS be_revenue_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN country_code = 'LU' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) AS lu_revenue_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'

SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE country_code = 'NL') AS nl_revenue_eur, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE country_code = 'BE') AS be_revenue_eur, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE country_code = 'LU') AS lu_revenue_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
